verdict.rationale: Daytona documents programmatic sandbox creation, SDKs, CLI, and an MCP server for agents to control sandboxes, but there is no evidence of a built-in scheduler, cron, trigger, or background automation runner that would let a user set up autonomous background automations natively within Daytona itself. Missing for 10: any documented scheduling/trigger/webhook mechanism, evidence of persistent autonomous background jobs, or first-party automation orchestration beyond on-demand sandbox execution.
